title: Belarusian diaspora protest against Russian nuclear weapons deployment in Białystok
reason: The gathering occurred in Białystok, Poland, outside Belarus; under the country-location rule diaspora actions abroad are not assigned as Belarus in-country events.
notes: Svaboda and MoyBY report Belarusian diaspora organizers assembled near Belarus’s general consulate, with placards against Russian nuclear deployment, occupation and the Lukashenko regime. Attendance is unreported; MoyBY links Charter97 as its source and the accounts are not independent.

title: Belarusian Political Prisoners Day solidarity rally in Vilnius
reason: The rally took place in Vilnius, Lithuania, outside Belarus; it is excluded from Belarus in-country event candidates under the current country-location rule.
notes: RFE/RL reports names of Belarusian political prisoners were read at a rally and 150 bags were displayed on Cathedral Square. Attendance count is unknown; target is solidarity with imprisoned Belarusians, but foreign location governs the exclusion.

title: Baptist street faith-sharing gathering in Drogichin
reason: Forum 18 describes the activity as sharing religious faith with passers-by; it does not report a demand made to the Belarusian government or state policy. Under the codebook, state intervention alone does not make a gathering a protest against the state.
notes: In-country event documented retrospectively. The May group’s size is unknown. Do not transfer the separate 'more than 20' count of local Baptists who waited outside a police station on 2 June to this May 27 gathering. This is a classification near-miss: a contemporaneous participant statement about the gathering's demands could change the decision.
